svg.title: Dub-Box input wiring: two combo-jack channels, shared power and phantom supply
svg.desc: Channel 1 and channel 2 each take a combo jack through phantom feed, coupling, protection, INA163 preamp and TL072 instrument buffer to the Audio Shield line input, with 0.1 microfarad decoupling at the supply pins, then the two negative-voltage chips, the bias divider and the MC34063 phantom supply.

g.text: Channel 1: combo jack 1 to LINE IN L
Channel 2: combo jack 2 to LINE IN R
Shared power: the two negative rails and the bias point
C1 and C2 = 10µF each. C2 + goes to GND.
Shared phantom supply (makes the +25.7 V net)

svg.text: clamp ×2 = two 1N4148 diodes: one from the node up to +5 V (anode at the node),
and one from the V− rail up to the node (anode at the rail).
All GND labels join one star point tied to the Audio Shield's G pad.
Phantom off: remove the +25.7 V link to the four 1.2k feed resistors.
A shorted pin makes a feed resistor dissipate 0.55 W: use 1/2 W parts if you can.
